package scenarionet

import (
	"context"

	syncsender "GENRE_MODULE/game/handler/syncsender"
	playerentity "GENRE_MODULE/game/entities/player"
	rules "GENRE_MODULE/game/modules/scenariorules"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/gateway"
)

// Command 是社交经营的接入：RoomID 是农场主人的玩家唯一号（换成 Player 的 Entity ID，客户端不能把别的种类的 Entity ID
// 交给 Sender），操作者取自鉴权会话。操作自己的农场只锁自己；
// 去别人的农场是 [主人, 访客] 两个 Player 的事务（两人都在本进程，同 friends 的双边动作），访客资格由持锁 handler
// 按主人的好友名单判断。没有房间，不用连接标识与代际。
func Command(ctx context.Context, engine *nest.NestMgr, session gateway.Session, request *pb.ScenarioCommandRequest) (Reply, error) {
	player := session.Principal().PlayerID
	command := rules.Command{Seq: request.Seq, Revision: request.Revision, Kind: request.Kind, Choice: int(request.Choice)}
	if request.RoomID <= 0 {
		return Reply{}, rules.ErrRule
	}
	owner, err := entity.BuildEntityID(request.RoomID, playerentity.EntityKindPlayer)
	if err != nil {
		return Reply{}, err
	}
	scenario := syncsender.NewScenarioSender(engine)
	var result rules.Result
	if owner == player {
		result, err = scenario.Sync_ScenarioOwn(ctx, player, command)
	} else {
		result, err = scenario.MultiSync_ScenarioVisit(ctx, owner, player, command)
	}
	return Reply{Result: result}, err
}
